NVIDIA DLSS SDK headers (include/*.h) and LICENSE.txt only, no binaries.
From https://github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS at commit 374959484e79a640feaba44c93ac8cfb0a03f5b5 (2026-09-08).
Not in the repository (the SDK license allows distributing it only inside compiled programs): get_deps.ps1
downloads them at build time and checks each file's SHA-256.
The DLSS runtime used at run time is the one installed by the NVIDIA driver (_nvngx.dll in the driver store
and nvngx_dlss.dll from C:\ProgramData\NVIDIA\NGX\models), both signed.
